meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可以按代码语法结构（而非文本）搜索和改写代码：支持精确匹配函数/调用/类的形状、批量替换写法、按 YAML 规则扫描。操作前会先验证模式并预览改动。
howto.when: 当任务是要按语法结构搜索代码、做批量改写，或用 YAML 规则扫描时触发；纯文本内容则走 rg/grep。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按结构搜索，返回匹配文件和位置。

say.text: 把代码里所有 console.log 改成 logger.info
say.note: 先 dry-run 预览，默认不直接改文件。

say.text: 扫描项目里的 YAML 规则，列出违规项

howto.what_en: Claude uses ast-grep to search and rewrite code by syntax structure rather than plain text: structural matching, batch rewrites, and YAML rule scans. It validates patterns and shows a dry-run preview before any change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task is to search code by syntax structure, batch-rewrite, or scan with YAML rules; for plain-text content, use rg/grep.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Searches by structure, returns files and positions.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) across the repo.
say_en.note: Dry-runs first; does not modify files by default.

say_en.text: Run our YAML rules and list violations.
say_en.note: Runs the scan and reports violations.
